text:
Anna (SDK): heads up -- npm dist-tag for @redwood/sdk shows `latest` -> 2.4.0 but py wheel was published as 2.3.1, curlers seeing 500s
Jen (DevEx): saw errors on staging. Is this the partial publish we feared?
Sam (Release RM): deploy-bot triggered publish at 2581234500, looks like npm finished but pip failed on wheels index
deploy-bot: npm publish @redwood/sdk@2.4.0 succeeded
Anna (SDK): ok need immediate soft-rollback. Proposal: add dist-tag `canary` -> 2.4.0, move `latest` back to 2.3.1, and yank the problematic npm tarball
Jen (DevEx): +1. Also update pipy to pin 2.3.1 in quick compatibility shim for now
Lee (ReleaseManager): what commands? I'll run
Anna (SDK): run:
``
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.1 latest
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.4.0 canary
npm unpublish @redwood/sdk@2.4.0 --force  # warn: npm may block, fall back to tag
```
Jen (DevEx): for py: `pip index versions redwood-sdk` then `upload 2.3.1` if missing
Sam (Release RM): I'm going to open a quick release note blurb and add a deprecation note for the old sync client that broke
Sam (Release RM): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 (post-publish fix + rollback steps)
Anna (SDK): starting the tag flip now, will post status
deploy-bot: initiated dist-tag update (requester: Lee) at 2581234600
Lee (ReleaseManager): done the npm tag flips, `latest` points to 2.3.1 again. canary -> 2.4.0
Anna (SDK): confirmed npm tags look good. py wheels still showing pending on CI
Jen (DevEx): can we soft-deprecate 2.4.0 in docs to avoid new adopters? Add banner on docs site
Sam (Release RM): adding a short 'do not use 2.4.0' in release notes and email to internal channels
Anna (SDK): follow-up: we will hold final publish until wheels and integration tests green. Target window: 2 hours
Jen (DevEx): rollback checklist:
- flip npm tags (done)
- set canary tag
- post in #general + #support
- hold rollforward for 2 hours
- validate py wheel upload
Sam (Release RM): I posted in #general and bumped the `release-status` doc
Jen (DevEx): anyone want to add any other mitigations? rate-limit clients? feature flag?
Anna (SDK): adding a runtime feature flag to server-side to accept v2.4.0 clients only behind opt-in
Lee (ReleaseManager): good. if CI doesn't finish in 2 hours we'll cut a patch 2.3.2 with the hotfix and republish
Anna (SDK): ACK. I'll coordinate the patch and the postmortem
Sam (Release RM): recording thread, will include transcript in release ticket
Jen (DevEx): cheers :thumbsup:
